{{Quote|What flag do you fly?|Masked boy to Fern, KB, Neel and Wim|<ref name="No At Attin" />}}
A [[human]] '''boy''' resided on the [[planet]] [[At Achrann]], one of the isolated [[Jewels of the Old Republic]] during the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="No At Attin" /> Around [[9 ABY]],<ref name="SC Date">{{SkeletonCrewDate}}</ref> he<ref name="No At Attin AD" /> was on a scouting mission with fellow [[youngling]] [[Hayna]] for the [[Troik Army]] when they came upon a [[Skeleton Crew|group]] of younglings at the base of a destroyed statue. Aiming his [[force pike]] at the kids, he demanded to know what flag the kids flew, but they did not understand the question. Hearing a [[Hattan]] patrol, Hayna ushered the group of kids and the masked boy to hide from the patrol in a destroyed [[tram]]. The group later arrived at the [[Troik]] encampment and introduced the younglings, [[Fern]], [[KB]], [[Neel]] and [[Wim]], to [[General]] [[Strix]].<ref name="No At Attin" /> 

==Personality and traits==
The [[Gender|boy]] was a [[Color|dark]]-skinned [[human]] with brown [[eye]]s who wore a green Troik [[Clothing|uniform]] with a green mask that he could pull up to see without the mask's visor. During their patrol, he carried a [[force pike]].<ref name="No At Attin" /> 

==Behind the scenes==
The boy appeared in "[[Can't Say I Remember No At Attin]]," the fourth episode of the live-action [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'' and was portrayed by [[Rayaan Kamal Khan]].<ref name="No At Attin" />
